feed.title: Ben Emdon · notes
feed.subtitle: Notes on source control and code review at agent scale.

entry.title: Indexing the commit cloud
entry.summary: Agent scale, part 6. In a commit-cloud architecture, every index we need can be computed the moment a commit is created, for every change, merged or not.

entry.title: Merge-time code mods
entry.summary: Agent scale, part 5. When landing is a rebase and every commit lives in the cloud, a code mod becomes a script the system runs inside the landing rebase, everywhere at once.

entry.title: Code review for the agent era
entry.summary: Agent scale, part 4. The review surface needs a rebuild around agents and intent: review intent and consequence, not lines.

entry.title: Removing the merge queue
entry.summary: Agent scale, part 3. The merge queue is a human-scale synchronization primitive. Land fast, verify continuously, revert forward.

entry.title: Agent approvals
entry.summary: Agent scale, part 2. When agents author most changes, approvals become semantic policy plus intent review.

entry.title: Solving source control
entry.summary: Agent scale, part 1. Source control is solved when every commit, landed or in flight, lives in one place: the commit cloud.
